rulesMotto: Live Pure · Live Conscious · Live Golden

detox.label: Satvik Diet
detox.title: Eat close to nature
detox.desc: Sattva means purity, harmony, clarity. The diet is less about restriction, more about refinement — natural, simple, minimally processed food for a calm mind and light body.
items: Fresh fruits & raw or lightly cooked vegetables
Soaked nuts & seeds, in small amounts
Fresh coconut — the key satvik fat
Gentle herbs: ginger, turmeric, cumin, mint
Avoid: processed, fried, meat, alcohol, onion & garlic

detox.label: 16:8 Fasting
detox.title: 16 hours of rest, 8 to nourish
detox.desc: Time-restricted eating gives the body a daily healing window. Choose the rhythm that fits your life and keep it consistent.
items: Early window — eat 8:00 AM to 4:00 PM
Standard window — eat 12:00 PM to 8:00 PM
Only water during the fasting hours
Begin with ease, not perfection — the body adapts

detox.label: Smoothies
detox.title: Seven detox smoothies
detox.desc: One light smoothie breaks the fast each day — rotate through the week.
items: Coconut · Coconut-green · Watermelon mono
Papaya · Cucumber-mint · Bottle gourd · Ash gourd
2–4 ingredients max, kept thin
No sugar, dairy or powders — drink immediately

detox.label: Salad Bowl
detox.title: The satvik bowl formula
detox.desc: One vibrant bowl for the evening meal — natural color, simple combination, clean digestion, no dressing.
items: 50% vegetables · 20–30% fruit
10–15% fresh coconut + a small handful of nuts
Fresh herbs on top — coriander, mint, curry leaves
5–7 ingredients max · eat the rainbow of natural colors

detox.label: Probiotics
detox.title: Beetroot-carrot kanji
detox.desc: A traditional fermented drink that supports gut balance — helpful bacteria in moderation, not excess.
items: Beetroot + carrot sticks + mustard seeds in water
Ferment 2–4 days in a warm place, stir daily
Drink 100–200 ml with meals, once or twice a day
Pause if bloated — the gut needs balance, not loading

detox.label: Daily Routine
detox.title: One golden day
detox.desc: The whole program in a single daily rhythm — repeat for 41 days, once every 6 months.
items: Morning — plain water, light walk (fasting)
12 PM — break the fast with one detox smoothie
5–7 PM — one satvik salad bowl
8 PM — the fast begins again · water only
